newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia arrests fugitive paramilitary leader.
newsitem.headline: Colombia arrests fugitive paramilitary leader.

text.p: An accused right-wing paramilitary leader linked to multiple killings in central and northwest Colombia was arrested in the nation's capital on Friday, authorities said.
National Police chief Gen. Rosso Jose Serrano said Luis Alfredo Rubio was wanted on eight outstanding charges, including "murder for terrorist ends" and sponsorship of paramilitary activity.
He also said Rubio was believed respeonsible for a massacre in the late 1980s in which at least 22 people were killed.
"This is a very important arrest," Serrano said.
Rubio served as mayor of Puerto Boyaca, a town 75 miles (120 km) northwest of Bogota until his arrest in 1990 because of his alleged responsibility for right-wing death squad activity.
He broke out of jail the same year and Serrano said Rubio had been a fugitive ever since.
